data.one_liner: Access and query call history logs on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to read, query, delete, and export device call history logs. Supports Android platforms only.
use_when: You need to display or analyze call history logs within an Android application.
You need to export or delete call log entries programmatically.
avoid_when: Your application targets iOS, as iOS does not provide an API for accessing call history.
You only require basic device info or sharing capabilities without call log access.
strengths: Provides straightforward methods to query call logs with custom parameters like date ranges and durations.
Supports deleting specific or all call logs as well as exporting to JSON.
Handles checking and requesting runtime permissions automatically.
weaknesses: Android only; completely unsupported on iOS due to platform limitations.
Requires manual addition of native Android permissions and gradle build configurations.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding Android permissions (READ_CALL_LOG, WRITE_CALL_LOG, READ_PHONE_NUMBERS) and enabling coreLibraryDesugaring in build.gradle.
